name: [FIXED] Blocks n' Props
desc:
(Check out the Recode: https://www.roblox.com/games/123397029712156/Blocks-n-Props-Recode)

Welcome to Blocks n' Props, a Recreation of Gmod Jenga.

In this game, there's two teams. The Tower team and the Destroyer team.

As a Destroyer, you have to knock everyone off the tower, with whatever props you prefer to launch.

As a Tower person, you want to remain on the tower at all costs, and avoid trying to get knocked off! Watch out for props coming in at high velocities!

(GAME REQUIRES TWO PLAYERS TO START)
